Senses.PreferredTarget: before your father and mother were born
AlternateTargets: before your parents gave birth to you
Senses.Explanation: Literally 'before father and mother had [borne you]' — the time before you were conceived and born. A stock question-clause of the record, asked about oneself prior to birth. Its dominant form is the pairing with (本來面目) — (父母未生前本來面目) ('your original face before your father and mother were born') — and its equivalents (那箇是你本來面目) ('which one is your original face?') and the bare (畢竟是什麼) ('ultimately, what is it?'). It appears in the surname pun of the layman surnamed Wan — (弟子姓萬)，(未審父母未生前姓甚麼) ('your disciple is surnamed Wan; but before my parents were born, what was my surname?'). As a set phrase (話頭, 'word-head') it is what one is told to investigate (參) and keep raising (提撕) — (幻有正傳) (Huanyou Zhengchuan) 'habitually made people investigate: what is my original face before my father and mother were born.' In the corpus an awakening-verse answers it with (本來無一物) ('originally not a single thing'). The clause is completed by a range of attested heads: …(本來面目), …(消息) ('news'), …(一句) ('a single line'), …(一著) ('a single move'), …(本來底佛) ('the original Buddha') — the last answered (本來無佛) ('originally there is no Buddha', 雪竇石奇禪師語錄). Recorded answers to the bare challenge include (八十翁翁輥繡毬) ('an eighty-year-old granddad rolls the embroidered ball', to 如何是父母未生前一句, 季總徹禪師語錄) and (風生壁下寒) ('wind rises — cold beneath the wall', 入就瑞白禪師語錄). The texts themselves pair the clause against (已生後) / (已生底) ('after being born'): (破山) (Poshan) answers (如何是父母未生前消息) ('what is the news from before father and mother were born?') with (金剛與泥神揩背) ('a vajra guardian scrubs a clay god's back') and the paired (如何是已生後消息) ('what is the news from after birth?') with (烏龜撞著石點頭) ('a tortoise bumps a stone and nods', 破山禪師語錄); another record answers (如何是父母未生前本來面目) ('what is the original face before father and mother were born?') with (屋北鹿獨宿) ('north of the hut a deer sleeps alone') and the paired (如何是已生底) ('what about after being born?') with (溪西雞齊啼) ('west of the stream the cocks crow together', 懶石聆禪師語錄). In a palace dialogue preserved in (古尊宿語錄) the master puts the question to the emperor himself — (師云如何是父母未生前一句上曰昨夜今朝又明日) ('the master said: what is the line before father and mother were born? His Majesty said: last night, this morning, and again tomorrow'). See (本來面目) ('original face', its constant partner) and (見性) ('seeing the nature').
Senses.Note: Overwhelmingly attested (771 raw occurrences across 201 allowlist texts, tags/notes/rdg stripped) and uniform — no master bends the base meaning, so a single corpus-wide sense is honest. The paired question (父母未生前本來面目) ('your original face before your father and mother were born') is the dominant form; (父母未生前) is a constituent of it (and of 父母未生前本來面目, which is not a separate entry), so per §5b the genuine semantic partner (本來面目) goes in RelatedTerms. Curated witnesses span three independent texts: (五燈全書) (X82n1571), and two Jiaxing (語錄) (J26nB177, J25nB171). Attested variants (Zen-scoped counts): (父母未生時) ('when father and mother had not yet given birth') 153x/74 texts; (父母未生已前) ('before father and mother had given birth') 119x/68; the full pairing (父母未生前本來面目) 92x/57; the challenge frame (如何是父母未生前)… ('what is … before father and mother were born?') 85x/56 (counting 何是父母未生前); the paired counterpart (如何是已生)… ('what is … after being born?') 19x/15.

Occurrences.Kwic: 父母未生已前。父母既生之後。六根四大三百六十骨節完具。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Yuanwu Foguo (圓悟佛果禪師語錄): Yuanwu Keqin contrasts before one’s parents were born with the fully constituted body after birth and asks how to approach the power on which both depend.

Occurrences.Kwic: 父母未生已前，便有報德酧恩一句。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Gulin Qingmao (古林清茂禪師語錄), instruction to Head Seat Hai: Gulin Qingmao says that before one’s parents were born there was already a phrase for repaying virtue and requiting kindness.

Occurrences.Kwic: 太原孚上座問鼓山：「父母未生已前，鼻孔在什麼處？」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Pufeng Fazhu Dong (浦峰法柱棟禪師語錄) explicitly quotes Taiyuan Fu asking Gushan where the nostrils were before one’s parents were born.

Occurrences.Kwic: 父母未生已前，何似這個時節？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chushi Fanqi (楚石梵琦禪師語錄): Chushi Fanqi asks how before one’s parents were born compares with this very season, after describing frost, warm sun, and cypresses.

Occurrences.Kwic: 室中問僧：父母未生已前，在甚麼處行履？僧擬對，即打出。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Jiatai Universal Lamp Record (嘉泰普燈錄), Cijue Puyin section: in the room Cijue asks a monk where he walked before his parents were born and strikes him out as he prepares to answer.

Occurrences.Kwic: 若論薦拔，父母未生已前薦拔已竟
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Yinyuan (隱元禪師語錄): Yinyuan Longqi says that, as for posthumous deliverance, it was already completed before one’s parents were born.
